title: Degree-zero representatives for etale inverse-limit cohomology
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(X,(f_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i$, let $F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $f:i\to j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $f_i^{-1}F_i$ by isomorphisms, its arrows being inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$, with coprojections $\iota_i$. Take $p=0$. Let $H:I\to\operatorname{Ab}$ have specified object isomorphisms $e_i:H_i\cong H^p(D_i,F_i)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and arrows conjugate to $H^p(\varphi_f)\circ D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Let $B$ be a cocone on $H$ with an isomorphism $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(X,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$ such that, for every $i$, its leg $b_i$ satisfies $e\circ b_i=H^p(\iota_i)\circ f_i^*\circ e_i$, including the specified identification $G_i\cong f_i^{-1}F_i$. Then $\forall y\in B_{\mathrm{pt}}\;\exists i\in I\;\exists x\in H_i:\ b_i(x)=y$. This asserts existence of representatives only.

source.place: Degree-zero case (09YN) and injective-system dimension shifting via 0EXZ and 0739; scheme passage via 09YQ, 0EYL and 04HR. Pages checked 2026-10-12.

proof.text: The affine projections make the limit qcqs. Apply Scheme.etaleCohomology_isColimit_of_isFiltered in degree zero. The plus-derived single-functor compatibility followed by rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf identifies this functor naturally with global sections; transport the image cocone along that isomorphism. Evaluation at the terminal object, H.equiv₀ naturality, and filtered group representatives lift the class in H^0(L) to a class z in H^0(G_i).

Transport z through eG_i and apply fixed-pullback degree-zero descent, obtaining x at j and f:i to j. Apply H^0(phi_f) to x and transport through eH_j inverse. Naturality of cohomologyMap and H.map, hG, and L.w f identify its image with z. hB and injectivity of eB give the required equation in B.pt.

proof_origin.place: Degree-zero argument factored into the existing filtered-cohomology theorem specialized at zero, natural global-section identification, and fixed-coefficient inverse-limit descent. Repair of duplicate abelianSectionsColimit helper.

mathlib_searches.query: Degree zero etale cohomology of inverse limits of qcqs schemes and compatible injective coefficient systems
Compatible injective sheaf systems on inverse limits have a surjective connecting homomorphism from lower degree cokernel cohomology
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits on local surjectivity, group-cohomology connecting maps and complex factorizations; no scheme inverse-system theorem. Loogle Sheaf.H finds H.equiv₀ and injective vanishing, but no limit descent.

mathlib_searches.query: colimit.*(Sheaf.H|cohomology)|cohomology.*colimit|connecting.*[Ll]adder in Mathlib Sites and AlgebraicGeometry; library inverse-limit descent
mathlib_searches.results: No Mathlib match; existing site connecting ladder has different site-system input, requiring scheme transport. Existing fixed-base class descent imposes torsion and does not accept varying sheaves.

mathlib_searches.verdict: Degree-zero identification and naturality only; none supplies inverse-limit sections or a compatible ladder.

mathlib_searches.query: Filtered systems of abelian etale sheaves admit compatible injective embeddings and dimension shifting maps on inverse limit schemes
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: structure-sheaf section descent and vanishing in AffineTransitionLimit, local representability and gluing.

theorem etale_limit_cohomology_degree_zero_descent
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (F i) 0))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (F i) 0) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map (φ f) 0) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    (B : Cocone H) (eB : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H L.pt 0))
    (hB : ∀ i : I, B.ι.app i ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) 0) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) 0)) :
    ∀ y : B.pt, ∃ (i : I) (x : H.obj i), (B.ι.app i).hom x = y
